purpose: section 2 requires inspecting the existing code before adding models or fields. This is that inspection, and it doubles as the migration justification section 15 asks for.

model.name: apps.pipeline.models.TaskReference
model.verdict: REUSE. No second model is needed and none will be created.

categories.verdict: the five required categories already exist. NOTE the stored value is 'color', not 'colour' — the brief lists 'colour'. Reuse the stored key and change only the owner-facing label, rather than migrating data for a spelling.

upload_persistence.behaviour: iterates request.FILES.getlist(kind) per valid kind and creates a TaskReference per file, before enqueue
upload_persistence.verdict: the wiring exists. It performs NO validation of any kind.

creation_ui.behaviour: five labelled file inputs, one per category, inside the Product Container panel; thumbnails container #ref-thumbs
creation_ui.verdict: category-per-file is already explicit rather than one bucket.

client_upload.behaviour: collects files per kind and appends them to FormData under the kind name; JSON path unchanged for packaging

review_board.behaviour: builds ReferenceItem(name=<kind label>, image_url=...) for every reference
review_board.verdict: a References section exists and is populated.

blocking_a_migration: image is an ImageField, which validates that the upload is a decodable image. Section 5 requires .pdf, .ai and .eps, and an ImageField will reject all three. This alone makes a field change unavoidable.
no original_filename — the sanitized stored name cannot be reversed to what the user uploaded
no media_type — section 6 requires the DETECTED type, and section 5 requires rejecting extension/content-type conflicts, which cannot be checked or recorded without storing it
no file_size — required by sections 6 and 8
no ordering — section 6 and the pipeline manifest both require it

no source classification (USER_UPLOAD) or status (REFERENCE_ONLY) — section 6 requires both persisted, and the REFERENCE ONLY badge in section 8 should read a stored fact rather than be hardcoded in a template
gaps_found.migration_verdict: REQUIRED, and minimal: one AlterField (ImageField -> FileField with validators) plus six AddFields on an existing table. No new model, no new relationship, no data migration.
not_blocking_a_migration: no size limit anywhere — no central setting exists, so one must be introduced and referenced by model validation, the view, the JS and the tests
no format allowlist — any file type is currently accepted
no filename sanitisation, traversal guard or collision handling beyond Django's storage default
creation is not transactional — a file failing partway leaves earlier TaskReference rows and their files behind
no authorization check on reference access — task ownership is not enforced when serving a reference
review board shows only a name and an image URL: no grouping by category, no filename, media type, size, timestamp, REFERENCE ONLY badge or empty state
no file-card fallback — a PDF/AI/EPS would be rendered through an URL and silently appear broken
no pipeline manifest — references are not exposed to the front half in a structured form

decisions_recorded_before_implementation.colour_spelling: keep the stored key 'color'; label it 'Colour Reference' in the UI

why_not_started: the remaining work is security-sensitive file handling — allowlists, content-type conflict detection, path traversal, collision handling, transactional creation and per-task authorization — plus a schema change, a manifest, Review Board rework and roughly thirty required test properties. Starting it without room to finish and verify it properly would leave a half-applied migration and partially validated uploads in the tree, which is worse than a clean stopping point. The inspection is complete and durable; the build is not begun.
